May 14, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Chesapeake Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 4.98% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Chesapeake Asset Management Llc sold 2,265 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 43,218 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.31 million, down from 45,483 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Chesapeake Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $926.95 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.38% or $0.72 $188.59. About 26.21 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
